payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_intake.py::test_a_criterion_declares_the_sets_its_claim_covers_and_its_positive_case stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A duplicate check across every set of a criterion, so one member text in two sets is refused.' applied to saffron/intake.py as an edit. The claim was 'A criterion may declare `covers`, a list of sets, and `positive_case`, one sentence. Each set has a `set` name and a list of `members`. Each member has a `member` text and an optional `driven_by`, which loads as `None` when omitted. Sets and members load in declared order. One member text may recur in two sets, and one set name in two criteria. A criterion declaring only `claim` and `witness` loads `covers` as an empty list and `positive_case` as `None`, and its `model_fields_set` holds only `claim` and `witness`. Load refuses nine shapes as a `SpecError`, each in its own spec. They are an empty `covers`, a blank set name, an empty `members`, a blank member, one member twice in a set, one set name twice in a criterion, a blank `positive_case`, an unknown key in a member, and an unknown key in a set. Each blank is whitespace alone. A repeated member shares only its text, with another `driven_by` and a member between the two. A repeated set name carries other members, with a set between the two.', and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
